## A section

This document is produced by `mcanouil-typst` as the site is published, so the layout, the typography, and the colours are the extension rather than a description of it.

## The components

The shortcodes and the divs are rendered natively by each format rather than passed through as HTML.

{{< value-box value="99" unit="%" label="Coverage" colour="success" >}}

{{< progress value="72" label="Progress" colour="info" >}}

{{< divider style="gradient" label="A divider" >}}

::: {.panel title="A panel" style="accent"}

Panels carry a title, an optional icon, and one of ten colour themes.

:::

## A table

| Option | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `style` | Chooses between the professional and academic layouts. |
| `brand-mode` | Chooses between the light and dark palettes. |

: The two options this document sets. {tbl-colwidths="[30,70]"}

The same brand drives the HTML and RevealJS formats, so a report, a page, and a deck look like one another.
